title: The quotient of a finitely presented algebra by a finitely generated ideal is finitely presented
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $S$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra, i.e. $S\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ as $R$-algebras for some $n,m\in\mathbf N$ and polynomials $f_j$ (Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00F3). If $\mathfrak a\subseteq S$ is a finitely generated ideal, then $S/\mathfrak a$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra: if $\mathfrak a$ is generated by the classes of $g_1,\dots,g_k\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, then $S/\mathfrak a\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m,g_1,\dots,g_k)$.
